subject: Walkling Court Planned Development District
overview: The Community Development Board voted to recommend approval of an amended site plan for a 45-unit mixed-use building at 590 Boston Avenue and voted to recommend City Council approval of the Walkling Court Planned Development District (PDD-3) zoning amendment. A hearing on a drive-through special permit at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway was continued to October 18, 2023.

items.title: Bank of America drive-through special permit, 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Passed over initially and later continued to October 18, 2023, without prejudice because the applicant's representative was not present.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue site plan review amendment
items.summary: Voted to recommend that the Zoning Board of Appeals approve the site plan review amendment for a five-story mixed-use building with 45 units and ground-floor retail, subject to departmental conditions and inclusionary housing requirements.

items.title: Walkling Court Planned Development District (PDD-3)
items.summary: Voted to recommend City Council approval of the PDD-3 zoning map and text amendment to facilitate the Medford Housing Authority's redevelopment of Walkling Court into 238 deeply affordable units across multiple buildings.

items.title: Bank of America drive-through continuance, 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Continued to October 18, 2023, without prejudice following a scheduling miscommunication with the applicant team.

items.title: Approval of minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from August 16, 2023.
